title: Once Upon a Book Club Alternatives: 6 Book Boxes - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a box like Once Upon a Book Club? Compare six book boxes by price, age, and format, from page-numbered wrapped gifts to picking your own read.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Is there another book box with gifts to open at certain pages?


Yes. Beyond the Book Club, sold on Cratejoy, sends a Christian fiction novel with three to five wrapped gifts labeled with page numbers. It has an Adult plan, a Young Adult plan for ages 13 to 17, and a quarterly deluxe box for adults with six to nine gifts.


Can you choose your book at Once Upon a Book Club?


No. Each plan sends one title a month, and the club doesn’t take requests. Hints go up on the 15th, and the team will tell you the title by email up to a month before it ships. For more say, Box of Books takes title requests, and Book of the Month lets you pick from five to seven new releases.


Where can I buy Once Upon a Book Club?


From its own website,[onceuponabookclub.com](https://www.onceuponabookclub.com/collections/subscription-boxes) , where you can subscribe month to month or prepay 3, 6, or 12 months.


Which alternative works for a teen?


Owl Post Books’ YA Imagination Box sends three new YA hardcovers a month for ages 14 and up. For gifts to open at set pages, Beyond the Book Club’s Young Adult plan, for ages 13 to 17, wraps three to five gifts around a Christian fiction novel.


Can I give one of these as a gift?


Yes. Each Cratejoy box has a Give as a Gift option on its listing. Once Upon a Book Club’s own gift orders are prepaid for a set number of boxes and don’t renew.
